048173:                 // The layout runs in bits, which is what the System V rule for
048174:                 // bit-fields is written in: a bit-field takes the next
048175:                 // available bits and only moves on to the next storage unit of
048176:                 // its declared type when it would otherwise straddle one. A
048177:                 // per-declared-type unit model instead started a fresh unit
048178:                 // whenever the declared type changed, so
048179:                 // `struct { int a:3; unsigned char b:1; }` measured 8 bytes
048180:                 // where every other C compiler on the target measures 4.
048181:                 u64 bit_position = 0;

048183:                 // `__attribute__((packed))` on the definition and `#pragma

048199:                 // One report per aggregate, whatever the definition got wrong:

048202:                 // bit-field share it, so the kind travels with the message
